rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese word for a classroom as a physical room.

example.english: Can this classroom fit so many people?
example.traditional: 呢間課室坐唔坐得落咁多人呀？
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 fo3 sat1 zo6 m4 zo6 dak1 lok6 gam3 do1 jan4 aa3

rows.note: A speaker uses this for a school classroom, especially in more formal or written contexts.

example.traditional: 請各位同學保持教室整潔。
example.jyutping: cing2 gok3 wai2 tung4 hok6 bou2 ci4 gaau3 sat1 zing2 git3
